The '''Jedi Temple communication center''' was a sprawling complex of chambers designated for the transmission and receiving of communications from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Funneled through the reception/transmission antennas which crowned each of the four [[Jedi Council/Legends|Council]] Towers of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], transmissions flowing along the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] kept the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] informed of goings on across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
Established within the Coruscant Jedi Temple before [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] the communications center was a massive complex with chambers spread throughout the Temple. The center was responsible for receiving and transmitting messages to and from the Temple from far off planetary governments and Jedi working in the field. The technicians stationed in these chambers were highly trained to be able to decrypt and analyze sensitive data vital to the operation of the Order.<ref name="LoE" />

[[File:Communication_center.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A group of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] inside the High Council's data room]]
During the early months of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] communicated with [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] from one of the comm center's private booths. Days after the [[First Battle of Kamino|Battle of Kamino]], Windu was distraught over the suicide of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] leader [[Merai]] during the battle.<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume 1: The Defense of Kamino">''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume 1: The Defense of Kamino]]''</ref> Several weeks later Master Yoda was back in the Temple and was summoned to the comm center by Communications Chief [[Ban-yaro]] in order to receive a report by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Concerning the undercover [[Battle of Lanteeb|mission]] to [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]], the Grand Master would opt to spend the night in the comm room so that he could take Kenobi's future messages as they came to the Temple.<ref name="CWG:S">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] suspected that there would be an assault on the Temple and its communications hub. Sending Jedi Anakin Skywalker to the communication center of the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]] which housed Jedi transmitter codes and crucial war information, Grand Master Yoda and Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] secured the comm room which serviced the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]]. While the Jedi were occupied with the communication centers, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-employed [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Cato Parasitti/Legends|Cato Parasitti]] were [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|infiltrating]] the [[Jedi Archives|Temple library's]] [[Holocron Vault/Legends|Holocron Vault]]. To further distract the Jedi, Bane sent his droid [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]] into the High Council Tower's comm center with a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] strapped to his back. While managing to infiltrate the center, the droid was [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|pushed]] back into a ventilation shaft by Master Windu through the use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="TCWHH">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref>

When [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], leader of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|captured]] High Council member [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] a holorecording was prepared and transmitted to the Temple. Receiving the recording in one of the comm center's briefing rooms, the High Council dispatched Masters Kenobi and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], along with Jedi Skywalker, to rescue Master Koth and defeat Grievous if possible. As a result of the assault on Grievous's fleet the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|First Battle of Saleucami]] broke out; while Koth was rescued, Grievous managed to escape.<ref name="TCWGI">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>

As the Clone Wars drew to its climax and the High Council began to close in on the mysterious [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dyne]] of [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] met Masters Yoda and Windu in the [[Jedi Temple central security station/Legends|data room]] to review their leads. Dyne discussed the potential problems that might be faced between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Xi Char/Legends|Xi Char]], and revealed that he had deciphered the code that Grievous had been using to contact the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]]. Soon after, General Grievous launched his [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|assault on Coruscant]] causing Coruscant's security shields to cut off all comm systems from the Temple. While Knight [[Lari Oll]] struggled to Master Yoda struggled to discern what Sidious' plan was. Attempting to raise both Masters Windu and [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], Oll failed but Master Yoda was able to stretch out in the Force and detected his fellow Jedi traveling about the planet. While deep in his meditation Yoda, for the first time, was able to sense the Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Sidious.<ref name="LoE" />

Days after the battle, Master Kenobi reported to the Temple and held a briefing on the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] in one of the comm center's briefing rooms. While Masters [[Shadday Potkin/Legends|Shadday Potkin]], [[Ma'kis'shaalas/Legends|Ma'kis'shaalas]], [[J'oopi Shé/Legends|J'oopi Shé]], [[Koffi Arana]], [[Melik Galerha/Legends|Melik Galerha]], [[Jurokk]], [[J'oopi Shé/Legends|J'oopi Shé]] and [[Olana Chion/Legends|Olana Chion]] attended, Jedi Skywalker arrived as the briefing dismissed, earning a slight reprimand from his former master. Kenobi would inform Skywalker that the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] had sent a shuttle to the Temple to take him for a private meeting in his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|private offices]].<ref name="ROTS" />

[[File:Serra_Keto.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Serra Keto made her last stand against Darth Vader in the communication center.]]
As the High Council discovered that Chancellor Palpatine and Darth Sidious were one in the same, the Temple was locked down as Master Windu and the Council moved to [[Showdown on Coruscant|arrest]] him. When the Masters failed, Sidious used his authority as Supreme Commander of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to set into motion [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] which would pit the troops of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] against the Jedi still stationed at the Temple. Raiding the complex the troopers, led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], destroyed the Temple. Having just secured the communication center's [[Jedi beacon/Legends|beacon chamber]] Vader began his hunt for [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]], one of the last resistance leaders at the Temple. On his hunt for Drallig, Vader was confronted by Knight [[Serra Keto]] in a briefing room near the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|base]] of the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]]. Dueling through the upper level of the briefing room and out into a hallway, Vader finally defeated Keto in a training dojo within the tower.<ref name="EPIIIVG">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]]</ref>

The comm center fell silent as the Sith analyzed and copied the data within the databanks. With the beacon chamber locked down and transmitting a recall-signal, it was tightly guarded by [[clone assassin]]s. When Masters Yoda and Kenobi broke into the Temple they quickly made their way to the beacon chamber and changed the code warning all Jedi to stay away.<ref name="ROTS" /> The comm center would survive along with the rest of the Temple throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and the rise of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="BRS">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref> While the [[New Jedi Order]] was able to occupy the Temple briefly, the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] saw the utter destruction of the complex. While the Temple was eventually [[New Jedi Temple|rebuilt]] under the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], whether the comm center was rebuilt as it had been is unknown; though it can be assumed it was recreated in some form if not the exact set-up as before.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>

==Layout==
[[File:JediHighCouncilGrievousTransmission-GrievousIntrigue.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The High Council and several other Jedi review Grievous's message.]]
A sprawling facility, the communications center was a multi-tiered complex within the Jedi Temple. While the main facility was centralized within the Temple, smaller satellite chambers were scattered throughout the edifice for use by the Jedi Councils. Several briefing rooms were used to inform those Jedi about to depart on missions. Filled with computer terminals, security panels, holoprojector tables, each chamber was completely hooked up to the HoloNet through the powerful comm disks in the Council Towers.<ref name="LoE" />

The main comm center was made up of several comm stations, including a high security chamber which was code locked. Access to the chamber was restricted and used for Jedi on undercover missions to contact the High Council.<ref name="CWG:S" /> The smaller chambers located around the Temple were used for briefings and lectures. Sunken two-level chambers, these comm centers were equipped with holoscreens on the walls and a large [[Holotable/Legends|holotable]] situated underneath. On the other end of the oval-shaped chamber were rows of seating for those attending meetings to sit and observe the presentations.<ref name="ROTS" />

At the base of the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]] was the comm center which contained the [[Jedi Temple central security station/Legends|central security station]] and the [[Jedi beacon/Legends|beacon chamber]]. Situated next to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|rooftop surface utility garage]] this sprawling hub serviced the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and their [[Situation Room/Legends|headquarters]] in the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]].<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>
